text:
anya: deploy-bot failed to promote build 2026.04.12 — CI pipeline is erroring out on the cache restore step in runner-eu-2, blocking the release. anyone awake?
ci-bot: [automated] job 9876 failed: cache restore error (tar checksum mismatch). logs: `/var/build/cache/restore: checksum mismatch for layer 42`
devin: saw the same. looks like parallel cache writes last night could've corrupted the cache shard.
jordan: runway — is this reproducible if we re-run the specific job? or is it a cache metadata mismatch only on some runners?
anya: re-run 9876 now -> still failing with the same checksum error.
sam: runner-eu-2 reported disk pressure yesterday, GC kicked in. possible partial writes.
maria: we're in a change window — what's the risk if we pin to last-good-artifact to unblock promotion?
jordan: pinning is safe if the artifact passed the full smoke + canary set earlier. we need to confirm the last-good digest: `sha256:8f3a2c...`
devin: we can do a manual promote to that digest, but deploy-bot will still run preflight smoke. if smoke passes, we can promote and then investigate cache corruption offline.
anya: deploy-bot is refusing auto-promo because the CI signal is red. can someone run `deploy-bot promote --image=sha256:8f3a2c --reason="manual-unblock-cache-corrupt" --force-checks=smoke`?
maria: prefer explicit approval flow. i'll give approval after we confirm canary smoke passes in staging.
ci-bot: kicked off smoke-run-1122 against sha256:8f3a2c on staging. logs streaming: `smoke-run-1122: all checks start`
sam: while smoke runs, we should create a mitigation: 1) mark cache shard eu-2 read-only 2) trigger a background reshard job 3) add a short-term TTL so corrupt keys expire.
jordan: agreed. i'll file infra task and tag eng-infra and eng-releases.
devin: FYI, if smoke fails we fallback to rollback plan B: build a fresh image from the same commit and promote that (slower but clean).
anya: smoke-run-1122 succeeded :thumbsup:. maria, you ok to approve manual promote?
maria: approved. manual promote go. logging the decision in the release notes: "Manual promotion to last-known-good artifact due to cache restore errors on runner-eu-2; follow-up: infra will reshard cache and enable TTL to prevent recurrence."
deploy-bot: [automated] promotion started for sha256:8f3a2c by maria — running preflight checks.
ci-bot: preflight smoke on prod subset completed OK.
anya: promote finished, release promoted to production, change window maintained.
sam: follow-up owner: jordan to run resharding ticket and confirm eu-2 is healthy before next release.
jordan: on it, starting the reshard run now, will update thread when complete.
anya: thanks all — logging this thread into the release postmortem and adding a note about cache shard health in the release checklist. :memo:
ci-bot: note: recommend adding a cache-integrity check to nightly CI to detect partial-writes earlier.
maria: agreed — add to next sprint.
anya: closing thread once reshard completes.
